send_intents.subject: Building the APAC full-stack platform
send_intents.message_body:
Hi Remote People team,

Your Full Stack Engineer (APAC) role stood out because you're building the infrastructure that lets companies hire across borders, and engineers own features from design to rollout. I enjoy that kind of end-to-end responsibility.

At Stride AI, I've built backend APIs and React interfaces, including cross-app authentication, and shipped features with tests. Outside work, I built Captar to put spending limits, policies, and tracing around LLM calls. I'd love to bring that product mindset to your React/TypeScript team.

Could you point me to the right person for the APAC role?

Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Devansh

other_candidates_held.reason: Role requires 5+ years and job location US/EU despite global hiring policy
Third-party job location lists EU countries excluding India
Toronto, Canada HQ outside permitted HQ regions
Requires 2+ years production ML experience not established
Application portal only, no role-appropriate verified email

notes: No Gmail send before 14:00 Asia/Kolkata. Do not mark confirmed until Gmail Sent and GitHub ledger durable.
source_discovery_note: Reviewed HN October hiring, official Greenhouse, company HQ/role source, and additional role boards; one candidate passed all eligibility/contact/fit gates. Several attractive roles were held for country restrictions, seniority mismatch, missing exact public hiring email, or HQ outside allowed regions.

daily_summary.note: No unverified addresses used. Gmail Sent proves outbound acceptance, not recipient inbox delivery. Remaining slots do not roll into future batches.
